interface.longDescription:
Atlabs is an AI video studio. Describe an idea, paste a script or upload a song to create animated stories, talking videos and music videos with consistent characters, locations and voices.

With Atlabs, you can:

- Create video stories up to 20 minutes long, including animated cartoons, explainers, script-to-video stories and narrative or performance music videos. Review and edit the screenplay and cast before generation.
- Keep characters, locations and props visually consistent across scenes.
- Choose from 50+ visual styles, including anime, 3D cartoon, cinematic realism and stickman animation.
- Give characters voices and lip-synced dialogue.
- Edit individual scenes: change visuals or camera angles, add motion, replace voiceovers, upscale shots, rearrange or split scenes, adjust transitions and color grading, and add B-roll, text cards and sound effects.
- Generate images, videos, music, sound effects and voiceovers individually, or upscale, restyle, reframe and trim your media.
- Export finished videos and download them from your Atlabs library.

Who it’s for

Creators, YouTubers, marketers, educators and storytellers who want to create animated videos, explainers or music videos without needing animation or editing skills.

Connect your Atlabs account to get started.
